text: Smokemaster Snarl is a saberon located in Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

Smiling Jade is a pandaren noodle vendor located at the Celestial Tournament in the Timeless Isle.

Small Savage Piranha are caught in the inland waters of Ashran for those with fishing skill under ~625. Players will rarely catch them with fishing skill above 650. Gutting them produces a random amount of Savory Savage Delight.
__NOTOC__ The Smelly Gravestone drops from Anetheron in the Battle of Mount Hyjal.
Small Merchant Order has a chance to be created by using Partial Receipt (Random).
__NOTOC__ Smoldercore Bulwark drops from Hellfire Assault in .

Small Pouch of Coins contains a monetary reward for crafters in exchange for their respective token: Secret of Draenor Alchemy, Secret of Draenor Tailoring, Secret of Draenor Blacksmithing, Secret of Draenor Leatherworking, Secret of Draenor Jewelcrafting or Secret of Draenor Engineering.
Smith Bran'miir is a draenei blacksmithing supplies vendor located in the Sha'tari Market District in Talador.
Smith Suldelaana is a draenei blacksmithing supplies vendor located at the Shattrath Residential District in Talador.
Smith Brinmaar is a draenei vendor located in Wrynn Artillery Tower at Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Smashspite the Hateful is a mo'arg brute appearing during the battle for the Broken Shore, summoned by . He is the third boss in Black Rook Hold.
A Winter Veil Carol is a story from Smokywood Pastures. It's the story of a miser named Scrounge. The story is being told by Guchie Jinglepocket.
The Small Football was created with Leatherworking; Taught by Pattern: Small Football.
Small Treasure Placeholders could be found as placeholders for certain vignettes in the Legion alpha.
Sminx Glasseye is a goblin vendor found in Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in Dalaran.
Small Ley Crystal is quest a reward from The Hunger Returns. These crystals can also be found scattered around in Leyhollow in Azsuna.
Smoke Grenade is provided as an objective for Dropping Bombs.
Slushy is a penguin who has been captured by the Squigglefin tribe on Seabreak Isle in Azsuna.
Small Legion Chest is rewarded upon completing the second stage of a Legion Invasion.
The Small Highborne Figurine is a quest reward from Lieutenant of the Tower.
Smoldering Familiars are found at the Temple of a Thousand Lights in Azsuna.

Smolderhide Thicket is a furbolg village found in southwestern Val'sharah. The Smolderhide's leader, Chieftain Graw, acquired a strange totem that corrupted the many residents of the thicket. After Graw is defeated Elder Sookh, one of the unaffected furbolgs assumes leadership and plans to rebuild their village. The village is comprised of two sections. The upper portion, which is vertical in design and comprises of many of the furbolg homes; and the lower portion, which is smaller and is where Chieftain Graw resides.
__NOTOC__ The Smoldering Ember Wyrm drops from Nightbane in Return to Karazhan.
The Small Charm of Inertia dropped from The Cow King during the Diablo's 20th Anniversary event or the Treasure Goblins from the anniversary event and A Greedy Emissary event.
The Small Charm of Life dropped from The Cow King during the Diablo's 20th Anniversary event or the Treasure Goblins from the anniversary event and A Greedy Emissary event.
Slyon is an owlcat found by the bridge in western Suramar. She sits beside her mate, Yowlon, and the two are surrounded by Feathermane Hunters and Feathermane Kittens.
__NOTOC__ Small Heated Metal Scrap is crafted with Blacksmithing. The recipe is only available during the quest.
This item will conjure a race specific boat every time the player enters water. The item is not limited to the waters of Thousand Needles.
The Smashed Portal Generator is the first required item to start activating Vishax's Portal, in order to reach Squadron Commander Vishax.
The Smolderhide tribe is a tribe of furbolgs inhabiting southwestern Val'sharah, on the Broken Isles. Some of them have gone into a frenzied rage.

Smolderhide Spirit Beads are a potential reward from the following Class Hall missions: *Aw, Shucks! *Ripe for the Picking *Oh, Deer *Murky Waters *Harping On About It *Queen of Stone *Nightmare Ritual It is also a quest reward from normal Val'sharah world quests and can be found inside Curious Wyrmtongue Cache.
The Smoldering Brazier is located across the road from Satyrnaar of Ashenvale. Using it will summon Krokk.
Small Azerite Deposits were :Azerite nodes found at Nazj'vel of Darkshore. They contained Azerite Crystals.

Small Azerite Shard can be obtained from multiple sources: *a quest reward from Infusing the Heart, WANTED: Jabra'kan and other quests. *War Campaign missions *Queueing and completing a random normal Battle for Azeroth dungeon
Small Coin Chest is a small chest located in the Hall of Shadows.

The Small Glowing Orb is located in the center of a device found on the balcony of High Sage Viryx in Skyreach. It starts and resets the puzzle for the Green Crystal Monocle, placing the Eye in the middle. Interacting with the orb, also places you under the effect of the Inky Black Potion, an effect that can be clicked away at any time, but which may help with the visibility.
Small Scorpid Carapaces were to drop from Clattering Scorpids. 6 of these were required for a quest provided by Kor'ghan.
Smith's Chain Gloves are a quest reward from Rest and Relaxation.
__NOTOC__ The Sly Rogue's Decanter drops from Jes Howlis in Tol Dagor.

The Smasher X900 is a clockwork giant piloted by Telzo Sparkspanner at the Forge of Wills in the Halls of Stone during For Gnomeregan!. When the mech is defeated by G.E.A.R., Telzo ejects from it but is subsequently killed when the giant's torso falls on top of him.
Small Metal Boxes are found during One Gnome's Trash with the Rare Metal Collector.
__NOTOC__ The Smelly Cleaver teaches you how to summon a Gruesome Belcher, an abomination companion.
The Small Boar is a boar located at the Ogre Ruins in Exile's Reach.

Small World of Warcraft is a World of Warcraft strategy board game developed by [https://www.daysofwonder.com/en/index/ Days of Wonder]. It was first announced at BlizzCon 2019 and released in September 2020. As the name suggests, it is a Warcraft-themed version of the 2009 board game [https://www.daysofwonder.com/smallworld/en/ Small World].
Smolderheart drops from Sire Ladinas in the Desiccation in Revendreth.
__NOTOC__ Smith Au'berk is a broker located in the Hall of Shapes in Oribos.
__NOTOC__ Small Coin Purses are looted from Grandmaster Vole's Tribute and Party Favor in the Ember Court.
Smoked Muckfish are sold by Slabchop and Delia in Revendreth for .

Smelly Jelly is a reward from It's In The Mix, which requires defeating all seven Pool of Mixed Monstrosities creations. It can transform you into a green, yellow, yellow-brown, red, or purple slime giant.
Small Coin Bag is found in Deadwash in Stormsong Valley after completing All Laid Out For Us once every week.
The Slumberwood Band drops from The Slumbering Emperor northwest of the road between Hibernal Hollow and Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald.
Smelly Musk Glands drop from Direwing Predators in Tanaan Jungle. Combining ten glands summons Rendrak.

The Small Offering Key is used to open the Offering Box found at near the Vault of Secrets in southern Korthia. The key itself is on the other side of the building from the box at up high. Use the damaged building to run up the side to reach it. File:Offering Key.jpg|Offering Key close-up File:Offering Key wide angle.jpg|Wide angle of Offering Key and ramp to it

Small Korthian Supply Chest is rewarded for finding a chest of Stolen Korthian Supplies (item) in The Rift of Korthia and turning it in to Duchess Mynx in Stolen Korthian Supplies. It contains roughly , 2x Korthite Crystal, and a large number of Shadowlands crafting reagents, including 3x Eternal Crystal, 6x Sacred Shard, 3x Elethium Ore, 6x Lightless Silk, 3x Nightshade, 6x Oxxein Ore, 6x Solenium Ore, and 6-24 common-quality items.
Smart Sandals are a quest reward from It's Gotta be the Horn.
The Smolder-Tempered Legplates drop from Azgar in the Ember Ward in Revendreth.
Small Chests can very rarely be fished up from waters in certain low-level zones, such as Darkshore or the Ruins of Gilneas.
Small Chain Links drop from the following mobs: *Deathseeker Eye *Stygian Bombarder *Silent Soulstalker *Observer Yorik *Stygian Stonecrusher *Helsworn Soulseeker
Smelter's Britches drop from Helix Gearbreaker in The Deadmines.
Smoldercloth Cap is looted from Scorched Satchel of Helpful Goods.

The Small Gardener's Satchel was obtained from the Gardentaur in the Queen's Conservatory.
Smoldering Coagulates are Azerite elemental oozelings located in southern Silithus: The Wound. They were killed by an Essence of Hati.
Smoked Seaviper is a Tuskarr Feast Reagent that is used near a Tuskarr Feast.
Smithing Apron is a Blacksmithing profession accessory made with Dragon Isles Leatherworking.
__NOTOC__ Ten Small Piles of Ash are found throughout the Spires of Arak. The respawn time is roughly 15-30 minutes.
Small Dragon Expedition Supply Pack is a quest reward from Dragon Isles Supplies (Renown 7), which is available at Renown level 7 with the Dragonscale Expedition and alts.
Small Valdrakken Accord Supply Pack is a reward from Renown Supplies in Valdrakken at Valdrakken Accord Renown levels 4, 8, and 14. It contains roughly 35 Dragon Isles Supplies.

Small Expedition Shovels are used by the Dragonscale Expedition (starting at Renown 5) to dig up Disturbed Dirt Piles. After the free one from Digging Up Treasure, more can be bought from Pathfinder Jeb at Dragonscale Basecamp for each.
Slyvern Alpha Claw drops from Snarfang in the Forbidden Reach.

Get hit by one, then immediately use the extra action button to throw it elsewhere: : Each second players are holding the bubble, they take damage: : The objective is to hop-scotch the smellibubbles back to the pot. Smoke Filter would be used to create a Standard Goblin Telescope.
Slyvy is a slyvern companion available for purchase from the Trading Post during September for 650 Trader's Tender.
Smoldering Enforcers are night elves found in the Smoldering Copse in the Emerald Dream.

Snakes are legless reptilian beasts and critters found all across Azeroth, Outland and . Many, but not all, are venomous. Most snakes are rather small, but some types have been seen growing to enormous sizes.
__NOTOC__ Snarlmane is a rare undead gnoll found in the basement of Fenris Keep in Silverpine Forest, being scared of its new occupiers. He is on a 4-6 hour respawn timer.

The Snap Dragon is a large amphibious quadruped tamed by the Naga and used as a war beast. They are capable of secreting a poisonous compound from their mouth which they can use in a ranged attack against both ground and air based enemies. They are bred at Spawning Grounds and are typically blue in color.

Sneed is an elite goblin found in the Mast Room in the Deadmines. Sneed was Edwin VanCleef's lumbermaster and pilots Sneed's Shredder. When Jerias Bloodvein invaded the Deadmines, he was killed by his crew.
The Smolderthorn tribe are a tribe of forest trolls led by War Master Voone that belongs to the Dark Horde.

Sneed's Shredder is an elite shredder found in the Deadmines. Sneed's Shredder is a giant lumber mill on legs. Sitting on top of the Shredder is Sneed who tries to chop everyone into planks of wood. Make sure you kill as many mobs as possible before attempting to take on Sneed, as he will occasionally use Terrify, causing your character to run in a random direction away from him. This could lead you straight into a mass of goblins if you haven't killed them yet, in which case the group will probably be wiped out. After you defeat the Shredder, Sneed will jump out and continue the fight on his own legs. He is still very dangerous in this form, do not attempt to loot the shredder or move on un
__NOTOC__ Snee is one of the two jungle troll companions of Harkyn Grymstone. Facts about his early origins are unknown, but he is said to be particularly violent.
Snake Burst Firework a type of firework that engineers can make.
__NOTOC__ Snagglespear is a rare gnoll found in the gnoll camps south of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He may be the leader of the Palemane tribe. He is on a 1-2 hour respawn timer.

Smoldering Pants drop from Ebon Slavehunters in the Wetlands. During , they were available via Crate of Salvage and Big Crate of Salvage. They previously dropped from Crimson Whelp in Wetlands prior to Cataclysm.

Smooth Pebble were low level bullets that added more damage than the Crafted Light Shot.

Smotts' Compass is an trinket. It gives a bonus to dodge. This is Captain Hecklebury Smotts' trinket. This trinket used to give a 2% critical strike chance to spells.
Snake Hoop is a quest reward from Willix the Importer (quest).
Smolderweb Carrier summons and dismisses a Smolderweb Hatchling, a spider companion.
Snakeskin Bag drops from Lady Anacondra in the Wailing Caverns.
Snickerfang Jowls drop from the following hyenas in the Blasted Lands: *Ravage *Starving Snickerfang *Snickerfang Hyena
Smooth Stone Chips can be looted from most level 36-72 elemental, and giant monsters.
Snellig's Snuffbox drops from First Mate Snellig at the Lost Fleet in the Wetlands. He's found aboard the boat closest to shore.
__NOTOC__ Snapshot of Gammerita was obtained by using Super Snapper FX on Gammerita in the Hinterlands.

Snacky's Journal is an award-winning comedy machinima series, created by the filmmaking team [http://www.stonefalconproductions.com/ Stone Falcon Productions], and filmed on the Silver Hand US server. The show revolves around Snacky the gnome, a hapless, gullible guy who can't say no, and his best friend Angie the night elf, an obnoxious, pushy but fun-loving gal who lures Snacky into awkward and/or dangerous yet hilarious situations in each episode. The format of each episode involves Snacky writing a journal entry which the audience hears in a voice over. Smolderthorn Headhunters are forest trolls found in Blackrock Spire.

Snarling Gribble Eel is the merchant ship owned by Grimm Onearm, and is one of the fastest ships in the eastern sea. It runs on a complicated perpetual motion engine that is fueled by his will whenever he steps aboard. He goes sailing on his merchant ship up and down the coast, secretly smuggling Horde supplies to roguish Alliance groups who care not for the affiliation enmity and only want the goods.
Smolderthorn Seers are forest trolls found in Blackrock Spire.
Smolderthorn Shadow Priests are forest trolls be found in Lower Blackrock Spire.
Smolderthorn Axe Throwers are forest trolls found in Blackrock Spire.

Smoldering Skeletons are skeletons located in Obsidian Dragonshrine and Maw of Neltharion in the Dragonblight. They are also found in The Deaths of Chromie dropping Sands of Time.

Snails are slimy, shelled molluscs. Most are tiny and harmless, but some types are monstrously large. Silkbead snails hide in their shell to escape the claws of nearby crabs. Shimmershell snails hunt for food just below the water's surface on the coast of Darkshore. Rapana whelks have been spotted fighting other whelks for prime food sources. Freshwater snails are sometimes cooked up and eaten as an exotic meal by the Forsaken. Magma snails are located on the Dragon Isles, mostly found in the Waking Shores.
Snevik the Blade is a gnomish member of Gnomeregan Covert Ops located in Frostmane Retreat in Dun Morogh.
The Smooth Amberjewel is created with Jewelcrafting (50); taught by Design: Smooth Amberjewel.
Smooth Alicite is a gem crafted by Cataclysm Jewelcrafting (1). It is taught by Jewelcrafting trainers.

The Sniper's Shield is a variation of the Sapper's Shield. Instead of the armored gauntlets that Sapper's Shields have, is has a port for a rifle barrel and a lower window that allows the user to fire a rifle while aiming from a kneeling position behind a shield.

__NOTOC__ Snickerfang Hyena Blood drops from Snickerfang Hyenas in the Blasted Lands.

Smothervine Seeds are provided as an objective for Aggressive Growth (quest) at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front during the Firelands Invasion. There are piles of fertile soil scattered around the Ashen Fields in the Molten Front. Plant these seeds in the piles, and a smothervine will grow almost instantly. A nearby elemental (or revenant) will be grabbed and strangled.
Snart Razzlegrin is a goblin found at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris.
Smolderthorn Mystics are forest trolls found in Blackrock Spire.
Smolderthorn Shadow Hunters are forest trolls found in Tazz'Alor in Blackrock Spire.
Sniff is a pandaren at Silken Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Snapclaw is a giant poisonous crab living in an underwater cave deep in Narsong Trench in Krasarang Wilds. It is decimating the local abalone population.
__NOTOC__ Snagtooth Pesterlings are virmen that spawn in groups of five from Chattering Dirt Piles in the Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.

A druid who famously used Green Whelp Armor during a battle in Warsong Gulch.
Sniffy Pete is a worgen found in Bizmo's Brawlpub underneath the Deeprun Tram.

The Snagtooth are a brood of virmen found in eastern Valley of the Four Winds. They have recently begun raiding most of the farms in the Thunderfoot Fields, stealing crops and tools. The tools that these virmen steal from Pang's Stead had an intention, they planned to use them to grow their own crops. Their intentions are seen as dumb, as they plant the tools in order to grow more tools, rather than using them to grow crops. The crops they have been stealing from Thunderfoot Farm, however, are not being used to eat but rather for fun. The watermelons they steal have been used a toy boats that they float on the Yan-Zhe River, while the turnips are taken to their nest and beaten upon.
Smolderos the Carbonizer is a core hound located in Mount Hyjal. He should be avoided at all times.
The Smouldering Stone is a stone located at Sargeron in Desolace.
Smooth Sun's Radiance is a cut gem that matches Yellow Sockets.
Snips is a rare scorpid located inside the western-most cave of The Cauldron in the Searing Gorge.
Snoot the Rooter is a rare boar located at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest.
Snaplashers are lashers located in the Conservatory of Life in Ulduar.
Snizzle is a goblin found in Molten Front as part of the Thrall's Thrashers in the raid section of the Firelands.
__NOTOC__ Snark is a rare hyena found at the Darrowshire Hunting Grounds in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Snipe can refer to: *Focusing Shot, a Hunter Talent added in Warlords of Draenor that was called Snipe during development. *The World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game card, Drums of War #31 - Snipe *The Hearthstone card Snipe.

Smoldering Offerings are looted from the Elemental Offering in .
Snappy is a crab located at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar. It's Matty's battle pet.

__NOTOC__ Snarlpaw Ledge is a saberon village in northeastern . This area was once the location of an orc village that was wiped out by the very tribe that lives here today. The name of the village is unknown, but the spirits of the deceased orcs remain here tormented by the Snarlpaws. Two Snarlpaw Dens are found here.

The Sniper's Crossbow is a crossbow resting next to a spyglass in a small camp just southeast of Drov the Ruiner's area in Gorgrond. It can looted for the Iron Lookout's Arbalest. The Spy's Logbook can be found lying nearby.

Smuggler Brutes are ogres located in the Shackle's Den in Azsuna.
Snaggle is a kobold miner appearing in Series 8 of DC Direct's World of Warcraft action figures. He was part of a two-pack, also featuring Brink Spannercrank.

Snapping Crab Claw drops from Leyscar Scuttlers in Suramar in Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ The Smoldering Treat is has a chance to drop from Shannox in the Firelands.
Snake Eyes was a battleship under command of pirate Giras the Guileful. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
Sniveling Swindler was a goblin located in Spires of Arak. He was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons to deal with Billy Boomballs.
The Smoldering Infernal Stone is a reward from Nath'raxas Breakout.
Snarler-In-Training Whistle is provided for the Wolf Training quests.
